steps.title: Create `src/utils/crypto.ts` for Web Crypto API logic
steps.description: - Implement PBKDF2 key derivation (250000 iterations) and AES-256-GCM encryption/decryption using the native Web Crypto API.

steps.title: Verify `src/utils/crypto.ts`
steps.description: - Read the file to ensure the logic was correctly implemented.

steps.title: Create `src/context/VaultContext.tsx`
steps.description:
- Implement context to manage authentication state, encrypted tokens, and auto-lock timeout.
- Use the crypto utilities to handle saving and loading the encrypted blob from `localStorage`.

steps.title: Verify `src/context/VaultContext.tsx`
steps.description: - Read the file to ensure it was created correctly.

steps.title: Create `src/components/Layout.tsx`
steps.description: - Implement a responsive layout with a Sidebar for desktop and a Bottom Navigation for mobile using `lucide-react`.

steps.title: Modify `src/App.tsx` and `src/main.tsx` for routing
steps.description: - Setup React Router with protected routes that check if the vault is unlocked via VaultContext.

steps.title: Verify Layout and App Routing
steps.description: - Read the files to ensure layout and routing are properly set up.

steps.title: Create `src/pages/Setup.tsx`
steps.description: - Implement Page 1: Vault Setup with a master password form and strength indicator.

steps.title: Create `src/pages/Unlock.tsx`
steps.description: - Implement Page 2: Vault Unlock with password input and card shake animation on failure (`framer-motion`).

steps.title: Verify Setup and Unlock Pages
steps.description: - Read the files to ensure they are created correctly.

steps.title: Create `src/pages/Home.tsx`
steps.description: - Implement Page 3: Home Dashboard showing hero banner, platforms status row, and recent activity feed.

steps.title: Create API Client `src/api/github.ts`
steps.description: - Implement fetch logic for GitHub Repos, Issues, and PRs.

steps.title: Create `src/pages/GitHub.tsx`
steps.description: - Implement Page 4: GitHub Management with tabs for Repos, Issues, and PRs.

steps.title: Create API Client `src/api/cloudflare.ts`
steps.description: - Implement fetch logic for Cloudflare Workers, DNS, Pages, and Zones.

steps.title: Create `src/pages/Cloudflare.tsx`
steps.description: - Implement Page 5: Cloudflare Management with tabs for Workers, DNS, Pages, and Zones.

steps.title: Create API Client `src/api/vercel.ts`
steps.description: - Implement fetch logic for Vercel Projects, deployments, and env vars.

steps.title: Create `src/pages/Vercel.tsx`
steps.description: - Implement Page 6: Vercel Management showing projects with deployment timeline and actions.

steps.title: Create API Client `src/api/netlify.ts`
steps.description: - Implement fetch logic for Netlify Sites, builds, and logs.

steps.title: Create `src/pages/Netlify.tsx`
steps.description: - Implement Page 7: Netlify Management showing sites with build status, logs viewer, and actions.

steps.title: Verify Pages and API Clients
steps.description: - Read files to confirm implementation.

steps.title: Create `src/pages/Activity.tsx`
steps.description: - Implement Page 8: Activity Log with chronological timeline and pill-style filter chips.

steps.title: Create `src/pages/Settings.tsx`
steps.description: - Implement Page 9: Settings with Security, Vault (export/import), Appearance, and Danger Zone.

steps.title: Create `src/components/ConnectionsModal.tsx`
steps.description: - Implement platform connection management to add/update/remove tokens.

steps.title: Build and Lint Project
steps.description: - Run `npm run build` and `npm run lint` to ensure the application compiles correctly and meets style guidelines.

steps.title: Pre commit steps
steps.description: - Complete pre-commit steps to ensure proper testing, verification, review, and reflection are done.

steps.title: Submit
steps.description: - Submit the finished code.
